current: GB 27887-2024 sets requirements and dynamic tests for child restraint systems themselves (including ISOFIX/i-Size CRS). Vehicle anchorages are covered by GB 14167-2024.
proposed: Reference record for GB 27887-2024 concerning child restraint systems for motor vehicles. The record does not contain the standard text; specific restraint types, dynamic tests and vehicle-anchorage requirements must be checked in the official standards.
